title: Building Ethical AI Governance
summary: Experts emphasize the importance of transparency, diversity, and inclusivity in developing ethical frameworks for AI governance. They highlight the need for multi-stakeholder engagement, environmental scans, and alignment with institutional missions and values. Effective AI governance can ensure that AI becomes a force for good, protecting communities and preserving democratic integrity.
